verdict.rationale: Intel marketing mentions an 'Xe Media Engine' for simultaneous play/stream/edit and Arc graphics for editing/rendering, implying a hardware media engine, but no documentation specifies actual codec support (AV1, HEVC, ProRes-class) or encode/decode capabilities. missing for 10: explicit codec support list (AV1/HEVC/ProRes), technical encode/decode specs, independent benchmarks confirming hardware acceleration.
